title: eucalyptus maculata var. citriodora
intro: Eucalyptus maculata var. citriodora, commonly known as Lemon Eucalyptus, is a variety of the Eucalyptus maculata plant, known for its distinctive lemon or citrus scent and its ability to repel insects. The health benefits of Lemon Eucalyptus include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and other respiratory issues. Therapeutically, it has been used to relieve muscle and joint pain, reduce fever, and provide relief from sinus congestion. The bioactive constituents of Lemon Eucalyptus include citronellal, a natural insect repellent with known antimicrobial properties.
